question: In which of the following states did the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) conduct the maiden flight-trials of the Stratospheric Airship Platform in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) conducted the maiden flight trials of the Stratospheric Airship Platform in **Madhya Pradesh** in May 2025.
 
• The flight trials were part of DRDO's initiative to explore and develop high-altitude platforms for strategic defense and surveillance.
